chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr asked him about a man who dies during travel while in the company of women, and there is no man with them: what should they do with him?
He said: “They should wrap him, wrapping him in his clothes, and bury him, and they should not perform ghusl (ritual washing) on him.”

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the situation in which the death occurs
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women; those present with the deceased man
key_terms.ثِيَابِهِ: his clothes; the garments in which he is to be wrapped
key_terms.يَدْفِنَّهُ: they should bury him; the burial instruction
key_terms.يَلْفُفْنَهُ: they should wrap him; the prescribed handling of the body
key_terms.يُغَسِّلْنَهُ: they should wash him; here negated, meaning no ghusl (ritual washing) is to be performed

ai.seo_question: What should women do if a man dies while traveling with them and no other men are present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for the case of a man who dies while traveling among women with no men present. It instructs that he should be wrapped in his clothes and buried without ghusl (ritual washing), indicating the practical application of burial law under constrained circumstances.
